# Scalp TP Ladder (GENERATED by backtest.scalp_tp_ladder)

Terms: [docs/GLOSSARY.md](../../docs/GLOSSARY.md).

Engine `66be26997` — OBSERVATIONAL, pre-registered (prereg_scalp_tp_ladder, register 106). Refinement-program extension; v0 UNTOUCHED; measurement only. The arms' own fires re-simulated under target {0.5 (incumbent), 0.25, 0.75, 1, 1.5}xATR(15M); 0.25 = the lower bracket (register 106 follow-through: expected spread-negative, included so the curve answers 'why not tighter?' with a measured row) — same one-tick haircut (register 94), same disaster stop, same EOD-flat; the incumbent reconciles to the journal (printed per leg). FIELD HONESTY: 80 cells (rungs x legs x arms x windows). STATISTIC SHAPES (74-B): per cell the register-105 consistency statistics — median-per-trade, win rate, weekly consistency, the gross-profit tail-carry cap — against B-RANDOM member bands under the identical rungs; reach rate and net descriptive (net = context only); the reach-decay curve is descriptive. A leg clears a rung when win rate AND median exceed the member band's max, both >= the incumbent's, not tail-carried; a candidate needs >= 3 of 4 forward legs. Single-leg optima go to per_market_watch.md wearing a selection-aware null (members' best-over-rungs), never straight to rules. Survivors propose BESIDE the register-101 v1 stop derivation — one geometry package, one ratification. Fill model: OPTIMISTIC target fill with the declared haircut (register 94); spread charged = the instrument's median cash spread; spread-as-share-of-win = spread / the median winner's gross move (RATIFIED 2026-08-30). Ex-lockbox.
